'''Trantos''', known also as '''Alpha 58''', was a [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|Alpha-Class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] who fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Secret Army" />

==Biography==
Alpha 58 was an [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando]], and he held the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]]. During the Clone Wars, he traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pzandias/Legends|Pzandias]] with a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], where they investigated a training facility that [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], had established on the world.<ref name="Secret Army" />
